title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E3 — Firing Line
Murdock and Frankie Santana ask Gen. Stockwell to help them rescue B.A., Hannibal and Face from a military firing squad.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E4 — Quarterback Sneak
The team joins a touring pro football squad to free an East German scientist; guests Alan Autry, Jim Brown, John Matuszak, Joe Namath.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E5 — The Theory of Revolution
The team must free three CIA agents from a Caribbean prison before an ambitious dictator strikes a deal with the Soviet military.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E6 — The Say Uncle Affair
Stockwell orders the team to steal a Soviet stealth fighter-jet, then is kidnapped by a free-lance spy (David McCallum).

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E8 — Homecoming
Thanksgiving draws Banner home, where his family needs his help; guests Diana Muldaur.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E5 — My Favorite Magician
A aging magician (Ray Walston) drafts Banner as his assistant for a benefit; guest Scatman Crothers.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E7 — Behind the Wheel
The owner (Esther Rolle) of an endangered taxicab company hires Banner to fend off drug smugglers.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E3 — Brain Child
Banner tries to reunite a gifted teen with her mother, who is accused of kidnapping; guest June Allyson.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E11 — Captive Night
Banner throws in with thieves to thwart a department-store robbery; guests Anne Lockhart, Mark Lenard.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E9 — Trust Doesn't Rust
Two thieves unleash KITT's prototype KARR, programmed without an instruction to protect human life.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E10 — Inside Out
Michael poses as a mob's getaway driver to stop a robbery and rescue a woman blackmailed into helping.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E3 — Show Biz
Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E4 — Virus
A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E5 — Peace Pipe
The Rampart staff struggles to save a girl injured by a drunken driver; Gage's Indian heritage becomes the topic of a feud with Chet.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E6 — Saddled
The paramedics rescue the driver and passengers of a school bus that plunged over a cliff; Gage dreams of becoming a rich rodeo star.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E7 — Fuzz Lady
Gage falls for an overzealous, undercover police officer (Sharon Gless); a series of thefts of equipment plagues Rampart Emergency.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E8 — Trainee
A former Vietnam medic volunteers to train as a paramedic, but his quick diagnoses and independent medical efforts yield disaster.
